comments.body: Which quest do the Armadillo pets come from?

wiki:
Acquired from: Lessons from mother nature
Pet deed is receivable from Trainer NPC in Seville, Lisbon, Marseille, Venice, London or Amsterdam on quest completion.

Required Quarters Rank: 2
Skill 1: Pet Plundering (Land) | Requires Pet Training R2, Intimacy 30
Skill 2: Area Search (Land) | Requires Pet Training R4, Intimacy 70
Skill 3: Additional Discovery | Requires Pet Training R9, Intimacy 180

Accepted Food: Live Prey (Cricket) (Intimacy: +2)
Favorite Food: Meat Balls (Intimacy: +5)

Different Color: Armadillo (Gray) Armadillo (Reddish Brown) Armadillo (Black)
